item.title: Tuscaloosa woman charged with stealing funds from nursing home residents
item.description: Alabama Attorney General Steve Marshall announced Monday the arrest of a Tuscaloosa woman for allegedly stealing funds from nursing home residents.

item.title: ALEA launches investigation following arrest of Aliceville police officer who was charged with child sex crimes
item.description: Days after several Aliceville teachers and a police officer were arrested and charged with various child sex crimes, the Alabama Law Enforcement Agency is now investigating the case.

item.title: Home2 Suites by Hilton presents plans to Trussville Design Review
item.description: The developer of a proposed Home2 Suites by Hilton hotel appeared before the Trussville Design Review Committee on Monday night to present plans for the extended-stay property at 6360 Misty Ridge Drive at Service Road.

item.title: Raising Cane’s plans 4th Alabama location in Trussville
item.description: Representatives from Raising Cane’s appeared before the Trussville Design Review Committee on Monday night to present plans for a new fast-casual restaurant at the former Pet Supplies Plus location on U.S. Highway 11.

item.title: 7 central Alabama women stuck in Mexico amid social unrest
item.description: The unrest in Mexico is causing trouble for some tourists. A group of women from central Alabama traveled to Puerto Vallarta for a girls trip, never expecting they would be sheltered in place and unsure of their return home.

item.title: Calera man charged with murdering girlfriend denied bond
item.description: A Shelby County man who is charged with murdering his live-in girlfriend was denied bond after appearing in court for an Aniah’s Law hearing Monday afternoon.
